correctness.rationale: All 2048 vertex subsets and all 715 Hasse cover incidences are exhaustively verified in standalone code. Two acyclic matching orders each yield 110 pairs, exactly one critical 0-cell and 21 critical 2-cells. Forman discrete Morse gives the integral wedge, not merely finite-field Betti numbers. Independent modulo-two boundary ranks confirm the size. All 55 affine maps preserve the faces and signed simplex traces yield the stated character; an orbit-fixed-simplex argument reconstructs these values. The cyclotomic module decomposition follows from the finite-group rational character.

value.rationale: The order-eleven Paley tournament is a canonical homogeneous doubly regular tournament and realizes the unique symmetric 2-(11,5,2) biplane. An exact integral homotopy type beyond the published small tournament census, together with the full intrinsic 55-element rational symmetry character, is an independently useful structural benchmark. The one-dimensional fixed line and two cyclotomic ten-dimensional factors are not implied by the classical design incidence parameters or generic vanishing bounds; no downstream theorem is needed for this exact natural classification.
